correctness.rationale: A full digit-carry bijection counts nonnegative even–even and odd–odd sum supports; mixed numbers automatically require positive summands. Inclusion–exclusion counts their intersection exactly. Pure numbers are handled by a separate exhaustive classification of zero, one and multiple unordered decompositions, including the base-four threshold. Direct independent pair enumeration passes 21 finite cases, 3,550,513 contributing pairs; finite tests support but do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: For a natural thin strongly minimal additive basis, the exact size of the nonuniqueness exceptional set is a motivated invariant not specified by qualitative density-one uniqueness. The formula yields a family-wide finite-cutoff census, a sharp growth exponent and an explicit base-four carry-multiplicity transition, not a single computed instance.
